notes.title: REPULSE: Galactic Rivals Goes Free-to-Play!
notes.notes:
[b][u]Get ready to attract, repulse, and dominate—because REPULSE: Galactic Rivals is going FREE-TO-PLAY![/u][/b]

It’s a cool couch game to play with friends, and we’re happy to make it accessible [b]for free[/b] to anyone who just wants to have fun. Whether you're looking for quick chaotic matches or intense skill-based battles, 

🔥[i]What is REPULSE: Galactic Rivals?[/i]
REPULSE is a local competitive party game for up to 4 players, where you use high-speed attraction and repulsion mechanics to control cubes across the arena. With 10 diverse game modes, 8 unique cube behaviors, and a punchy synthwave soundtrack, every match is a chaotic, high-energy showdown!

🎵 [i]Still need more reasons to play?[/i]
✅ 10 unique game modes with varied cube physics
✅ 4 rad, colorful environments to battle in
✅ 12 synthwave tracks by RADIANT.prk & Loic Bourdrel
✅ AI opponents with 3 difficulty levels—challenge or warm up against them
✅ Keyboard + mouse support if you’re short on gamepads
✅ Instant replays—because bragging rights matter

Whether you're hosting a game night, battling AI to sharpen your skills, or just vibing with the audio-reactive arenas, REPULSE is designed for pure, unfiltered fun.

[b]📅 February 20, 2025—get ready to repulse, attract, and conquer for free![/b]

notes.title: Mac & Linux versions are available!
notes.notes:
Hi,

REPULSE is now available on Mac & Linux! 
Grab some gamepads, call some friends, get some beers and have fun!

IronEqual.

notes.title: Mac & Linux versions are on the way!
notes.notes:
Hi,

REPULSE is being released today (yay!), with a Windows build. 
We already have MAC & Linux builds, but they need to go through Steam's verification process, and it may take more time than we expected. 

We just want to assure you that there will be MAC & Linux versions of REPULSE in the following days!

Thanks for your comprehension,
IronEqual
